rules.name: Iron Discipline
rules.description: Orders issued to this unit can be rerolled, and each score of 1 means a free order

rules.name: Responsive
rules.description: This unit can be issued an order in 40 cm from the General

rules.name: Sneaky
rules.description: This unit gets an additional +2 bonus for attacking the enemy’s flank or rear

rules.name: Will to Fight
rules.description: If this unit destroyed an enemy unit, it can move up to 10 cm instead of 5 cm

rules.name: Vigilant
rules.description: The enemy unit does not receive bonuses for attacking this unit’s flank or rear

rules.name: Snake Move
rules.description: This unit can move or charge through enemy or friendly units if its move ends outside the unit that it was moving or charging through

rules.name: Tomb Altar
rules.description: Each Wound the Desauros with Tomb Altar deals to the opponent means the Desauros gains 1 Wound. Desauros may have a maximum of 12 Wounds

rules.name: Primal Rampage
rules.description: When charging, Desauros must take a d6 test to see if it goes berserk. A score of 2 or less means Desauros gains +3 Attacks

rules.name: Hammer Strike
rules.description: For each score of 1 and 2 in the Wound Test, this unit can roll an additional d6 for wounding. The obtained scores do not generate new ones

rules.name: Living Catapult
rules.description: Once per cycle, Forgon can spit at an enemy within 20 cm that is not engaged in combat. Roll a d6. A score of 3 or less means the enemy unit must take a Panic Test for its 3 bases

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the enemy unit is engaged in combat with the unit that the Champion of Night is attached to, make a d6 test before the enemy attacks. A score of 3 or less means the enemy gets a -1 to WS modifier in combat

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the Champion of Death is attached to a friendly unit engaged in combat, roll a d6 for each base that the enemy unit lost. A score of 2 or less means your opponent must remove another base

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Choose a friendly unit within 20 cm of the Champion of Wrath and make a d6 test before that unit makes a charge. A score of 4 or less means that the chosen unit gains +1 to WS when charging

rules.name: Heralds of the Torment
rules.description: The Sorgax General is given the option to issue one additional free order per cycle if the opponent has suffered certain losses during the battle. Check how many Blood Points your opponent has lost so far and compare it with the table below to find out what score you need to get to successfully issue the free order:  6BP 1-, 12BP 2-, 24BP 3-

rules.name: Tomb Priest
rules.description: Each friendly unit within 10 cm of the Tomb Priest may add 3 cm to the charge range

rules.name: Kor'quixos
rules.description:
Kor'quixos is a Mage and counts tothe Mages limit in the army. May use magic items and spells.

The hero is communicating with powerful magic, which not only affected his mind, but caused his body to become monstrous in size. Thanks to this, he supports the unit with 8 attacks.

rules.name: Staff of Doom
rules.description: If an enemy comes into base contact with Kor'quixos, it immediately takes d6 damage. Additionally, once per battle, the staff's power can be accumulated and used against enemies – roll a d6 for each enemy unit within 15 cm. A score of 3 or less means that the enemy unit loses an Action Die.

rules.name: Thanox Crown
rules.description: Once per battle, Kor'quixos may choose any spell he does not have and cast it without taking the test. Additionally, that spell cannot be dispelled.

rules.name: Cyclopean Belt
rules.description: If the unit Kor'quixos is attached to was successfully issued an order on a score of 1, once in the cycle this rule is used, the unit may use Frenzy (When charging, this unit doubles its Attacks (A) stat).

rules.name: Implacable
rules.description: The unit Kor'quixos is attached to may be forced to make a forceful move or charge. If the player chooses to do so, they may change the unit's M stat to M 15 and roll a d6. A score of 4 or more means that one base in the unit must be removed due to enfeeblement.
